name: The Bowl
design_intent: SPORTS calm court #4 (v8_sports_courts.md tier 2, hazard=''). The center_pitch shell (2800x1600, strict mirror about x=1400 -- SAME walls/goals/ceiling/spawns, a known-fair symmetric base) with the flat floor replaced by a GENTLE SYMMETRIC BOWL and center_pitch's proven mirrored mid-caroms KEPT. The bowl: a wide flat centre segment (top y1350) stepping UP toward each wall (y1305 -> y1245) so the risers act as soft return-walls -- a ball drifting toward a wall climbs a riser and is nudged back toward play (the hook: the ball naturally returns to centre). The step is deliberately GENTLE (near-wall floor only y1245, ~300px below the goal-mouth bottom y950 -- the SAME lofted-shot difficulty as center_pitch's flat y1350 floor) so scoring still needs a genuine boosted loft, not a cheap near-wall pop; and the two mid-caroms (x1000/x1660, y380, the center_pitch pair) are RETAINED to scatter the returning ball so neither team can snowball a dead-centre re-capture. FAIRNESS NOTE: an earlier, STEEPER version (near-wall floor y1140, caroms removed) funnelled every ball into a hot dead-centre scramble that let the first-touch team snowball -> a measured ~74% one-team lean over 5 bot matches. Softening the bowl to center_pitch's scoring difficulty + restoring its caroms removes that amplifier while keeping the return-to-play read. NO hazards, NO powerup_spawners (SYM-6, SC-CALM-CLEAN). SYMMETRY (SC-SYM, the CD #7 fix): every floor segment + both caroms are vertical-axis mirrors about x=1400 at the SAME y as their twin, so both halves funnel identically under gravity -- no static side bias. FLIGHT GATE (GAME_ESSENCE Rule A, verbatim from center_pitch): centre x=1400; nearest inner spawn x=700/2100 -> 700px to centre (> 527 spring drift, >> 395 trampoline drift); centre-to-far-goal 1400->240 = 1160px, so reaching the kickoff ball and pressing it to the far goal REQUIRE boost. Full trampoline bowl floor + bumper walls/ceiling -> no flat standable ground (Pillar 2). Goal mouth y650..950 each end (goal_zone x=240 team0 / x=2560 team1, w140 h300); back walls seal the pockets.
